info.title: Kronikol CLI
info.description: Command-line companion for Kronikol. Includes `kronikol merge`, which combines several mergeable TestRunReport.json files (produced with GenerateMergeableData enabled — e.g. by parallel CI runners) into a single combined TestRunReport.html; `kronikol ingest`, which replays language-neutral NDJSON interaction captures (from an out-of-process proxy tap or any non-.NET capturer) into a full Kronikol report; and `kronikol query`, which answers questions about a TestRunReport.json — why a test failed, what a service returned, where a wrong value came from — without loading the file, so a 10 MB report is debuggable by tooling and by AI agents.

options.name: --tests
options.description: Tests NDJSON (start/step/end records) supplying outcome, duration and steps.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory (default: ./Reports).

options.name: --render
options.description: browserjs (default, needs internet at view time) | nodejs | local | server.

options.name: --title
options.description: Report title.

options.name: --feature
options.description: Feature name for tests without one (default: Ingested).

options.name: --no-collapse
options.description: Collapse consecutive identical calls into a loop fragment (default: on).

options.name: --max-arrows
options.description: Cap request/response pairs per diagram; the rest is summarised.

options.name: --browser-render-workers
options.description:
Web Workers the browserjs report renders diagrams on (default: 4, capped by
the viewer's CPU count); 0 renders on the main thread as before 3.0.45.

options.name: --no-component-diagram
options.description: Skip ComponentDiagram.html.

options.name: --no-redact
options.description: Do not redact credential headers at ingest (default: redact).

options.name: --redact-header
options.description: Additional header to redact (repeatable).

options.name: --allow-empty
options.description: Generate even when nothing was ingested.

options.name: --chronological
options.description:
Strict timestamp order (default: call-tree order — each response follows its
request, calls made while handling a request nest inside it).

options.name: --merge-duplicates
options.description:
Fold the wire and span views of the same call into one arrow (a proxy/TCP tap
and an OTLP span tap both saw it): span trace id, wire body and status.

options.name: --cucumber-messages
options.description:
Cucumber Messages NDJSON (repeatable) — playwright-bdd's cucumberReporter('message'),
cucumber-js --format message, Cucumber-JVM --plugin message. Its Gherkin structure
wins over --tests for the scenarios it owns.

options.name: --include-hooks
options.description: Keep Cucumber hook steps (BeforeEach hook and friends) in the step list.

options.name: --fold-unknown
options.description:
Collect interactions of test ids absent from --tests into one scenario
with this name (e.g. "Traffic outside any test").

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail on the first malformed capture line (default: skip and report them).

options.name: --no-capitalise
options.description:
Leave step/assertion labels and feature/rule/scenario titles exactly as
the producer wrote them (default: upper-case the first letter of
keyword-less labels and of every title).

options.name: --attribute-by-window
options.description:
Attribute interactions that carry no testId to the test that was
running at their timestamp; the optional id is the capturer's
fallback marker (e.g. "session") which counts as "no testId".

options.name: --run-window
options.description:
Keep only this run's traffic: drop interactions whose request lies before
the earliest tests record (a testrun/started marker, if the host writes one)
or after the testrun end marker — the previous run's and the stack's start-up
traffic otherwise lands in --fold-unknown.

options.name: --run-start
options.description: Explicit run window bounds (UTC); each implies --run-window.

options.name: --phase-from-steps
options.description:
Give interactions the phase of the Given/When/Then step they happened
during, so setup traffic can be separated or highlighted.

options.name: --clean-attachments
options.description: Empty the report's attachments/ folder first, so it holds this run only.

options.name: --diagnostic
options.description:
health: "CaptureDegraded:tap-di-redis: decoding disabled on 1 connection".
kind = a DiagnosticKind name (unknown → Other); it lands in IngestResult.Diagnostics,
the report's "Report diagnostics" section and TestRunReport.json's diagnostics array.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

arguments.name: INPUTS
arguments.description: Files, directories (searched recursively for *.ndjson / *.jsonl), or globs.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output HTML path (default: TestRunReport.html).

options.name: --title
options.description: Report title (default: "Test Run Report").
